name: Youth Volunteering at the Food Bank of Contra Costa and Solano
org: Food Bank of Contra Costa and Solano
city: Concord, CA (warehouse and distribution sites across Contra Costa County)
what_you_do: Help get food to neighbors in need. Volunteers work at food warehouses in Concord and Fairfield and at community food distribution sites. You sign up for a shift on the volunteer calendar.
who_can_apply: Youth 16 and up can make their own volunteer account and sign up for some shifts. Youth 11 to 15 can volunteer with an adult.
deadline_text: Shifts are posted on the volunteer calendar. You must sign up for a shift ahead of time because walk-ins are not allowed.
how_to_apply: Register as a Food Bank volunteer on its volunteer site. Pick a shift on the calendar. If you are 11 to 15, a parent or guardian signs up too and adds you with the Sign up with a Team button.
notes: The rules for youth come from the Food Bank volunteer FAQ. Youth 5 to 10 can only volunteer at the Family Food Sorts. Youth under 5 cannot volunteer at the Food Bank. Team captains must be 16 or older. The FAQ lists the volunteer help desk as volunteerhelpdesk@foodbankccs.org or 855-309-3663, extension 605. The Food Bank hosts groups too, and a group can send a Group Volunteer Request. Youth 16 and up can sign up for select shifts. The shift details show which ones.
